## Context / Problem
The infra/scripts cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The audit is pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope
- `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:1-36,49-274,307-366,405-456,468-561,617-740,811-871,908-1019,1057-1108,1158-1316` — Preserve component markers/backoff, drain and readiness bounds, disk-pressure state, path-trigger sets, secret refresh ordering, blue-green pointer swap/rollback, proof-before-stop rules, health/write probes, observability materialization. Consumer: systemd/operators/tests that inspect constants.
- `infra/scripts/bootstrap-gerrit-admin.sh:1-23,32-37` — Preserve one-time account/bootstrap purpose, secret handling, idempotency, required account check. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/scripts/compose-up.sh:1-12,24-40,78-90,102-159,190-214` — Preserve authoritative site-subdir list/enumeration mode, bind-volume creation, scratch markers, one-time plugin seed, fail-closed config materialization. Consumer: operators/config checks.
- `infra/scripts/config-check.sh:1-22,71-99` — Preserve deterministic config validation scope, YAML parsing policy, volume/source parity and drift check. Consumer: deployment gate/operators.
- `infra/scripts/fetch-secrets.sh:1-37,121-155,170-234,276-280` — Preserve required versus optional reads, fallback rules, always-create file semantics, file modes, bearer/Jira materialization, deliberate env omission. Consumer: boot/deployment scripts.
- `infra/scripts/install-autodeploy.sh:1-16` — Preserve idempotent unit install, mirror bootstrap, timer intentionally disabled pending manual verification. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/scripts/install-certbot-timer.sh:1-24` — Preserve host nginx, dnf/venv fallback, HTTP-01 webroot, twice-daily renewal/reload, args/idempotency. Consumer: operators.
- `infra/scripts/materialize-mcp-upstream.sh:1-28` — Preserve validated target format, atomic include generation, safe default/failure behavior, inputs. Consumer: nginx/autodeploy.
- `infra/scripts/materialize-opcert-guard.sh:1-37` — Preserve secret source, hash/map output, file permissions, atomic replacement, fail-closed empty/missing behavior. Consumer: nginx/operators.
- `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:1-27,34-54,82-85,106-168,229-264,320-362` — Preserve persistent ticket/code clones, lock discipline, relative deletion safety, credential-helper isolation, clone validation/convergence, no secret logging. Consumer: MCP container.
- `infra/scripts/observability.sh:1-40,74-127,145-228,259-302,335-390,444-550,568-652,659-725,737-826` — Preserve metric contracts, unconditional heartbeats, missing/log-rotation handling, bounded process census, offsets/deltas, MCP/reviewbot/g2p/autodeploy failure signals, mirror divergence and exit behavior. Consumer: systemd/CloudWatch alarms/operators.
- `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh:1-27,55-74,164-167` — Preserve durable tickets clone, global identity necessity, full-history convergence, ensure-registry invocation. Consumer: review-bot container.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [ ] Every preserve item in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by the row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] Every consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by the row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] No executable behavior changes; verified by inspecting the final diff and running the command under Verification.
- [ ] No test assertion changes; verified by inspecting the final diff.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
